analysis: The trial completed successfully with host macro validation HR@10=0.5625, slightly below the prior 0.5637 reference. Category HR@10: Movies_and_TV 0.595, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.615, Electronics 0.370, CDs_and_Vinyl 0.670. Category-specific fusion selection therefore did not improve the host aggregate. Searching five weights guarantees performance at least as high as equal fusion only on the identical cached local validation cases; that guarantee does not extend to independent host evaluation. Selected weights and local diagnostics are absent from the supplied result, so the regression cannot be attributed to a particular expert or category weight. Retain this as evidence that local fusion tuning did not transfer into an aggregate improvement in this trial.
code_summary: Preserved the SASRec and MultVAE experts and their independent checkpoint selection. SASRec combines causal self-attention with a gated cumulative-history preference representation; MultVAE reconstructs binary user histories with an annealed KL loss. Fusion uses item-ID-tiebroken, one-based candidate ranks: w/(60+sas_rank)+(1-w)/(60+vae_rank). After training, cached local validation ranks select w from {0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1} by integer HR@10 hits, with ties favoring proximity to 0.5 then lower weight. Category metadata persists the selected weight, and the generated predictor loads it through shared fusion logic. Added checks for endpoints, ties, permutations, checkpoint reload, and exported predictor agreement. Preserved all four dataset routes, supplied splits, seed 42 training/evaluation, trial-local artifacts, single-GPU execution, and the 200-epoch default.
